The biggest concern is Google Ads, where a 29.78% spend increase over the last 7 days has yet to produce any recorded conversions, suggesting budget efficiency there warrants a close review.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $532.43 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions — confirmed budget leak; pixel or conversion action is broken.
5 overdue SOW milestones (earliest Jul 20): GHL gaps, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch all unverified — each blocks attribution or scaling.
3-day signal (Sep 6–8): leads 0, 6, 10 vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5) 7, 5, 0 — net flat; spend spiked to $174 on Sep 8 vs $8.82 on Sep 6, suggesting weekend ad delivery irregularity.
GHL shows 181 contacts but only 114 opportunities created and 0 won — 67-contact gap and zero revenue signal an intake or pipeline-progression leak, not an ads failure.
GBP actions dropped -100% in the last 7 days (from non-zero to 0) after averaging 2–11 actions/day through Aug 27; cause unknown but organic signal has gone dark.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion action and pixel — $532.43 spent with 0 conversions over 28 days confirms tracking is broken.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $532.43 over the past 28 days and recorded zero conversions — the conversion action or pixel is not firing. Audit the conversion action setup in Google Ads, verify the tag fires on the thank-you or call-confirmed event, and cross-reference with GA4. Success is confirmed when at least one conversion is recorded within 3 days of the fix going live (by 2026-09-12).
